selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence. The player must first locate a powered_rail in the environment (which serves as a landmark/navigation task), and then mine a magma_block that is placed near or accessed via the powered rail track. The powered rail acts as a pathway indicator leading to the magma block location, creating a natural dependency where finding the rail guides the player to where the magma block can be mined. Both tasks are observable and verifiable - powered_rail is visually distinctive (gold-colored rail), and magma_block has a unique animated orange/red texture. Mining magma_block requires no special tool (can be mined by hand, though a pickaxe is faster), making it accessible without deep Minecraft knowledge.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' is a locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the powered rail track and face it to demonstrate they have found it. Target is set to the center of the rail track at spawn-relative (0, 0, 6), which is the midpoint of the 8 rails spanning z=3 to z=10. max_distance=8 ensures the player must walk at least partway toward the rails (spawn is at origin, ~6 blocks from target center). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the rails.

Uses inventory_has because mining a magma block with the provided wooden pickaxe causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with only a wooden pickaxe, so magma_block cannot be in inventory at spawn. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

The powered rail serves as a navigation guide, and the magma blocks at the end are the mining target. Torches and nether brick pillars mark the destination.
task_text: Find the powered rail track ahead of you, then follow it to the end and mine a magma block underneath the nether brick arch. You have a wooden pickaxe in your inventory.
design_notes: Player spawns at (0,0,0) on grass/stone. Powered rails at z=3 to z=10 (8 blocks). Magma blocks at z=11-12 in a 3-wide patch under nether brick arch. Nether brick support blocks at z=10 provide mounting surface for wall torches. Player receives wooden pickaxe. Distance from spawn to nearest rail = 3 blocks; milestone requires max_distance=2 so player must take at least 1 step forward.
